thread:
maya.sre: Quick broadcast — planned US‑EAST maintenance this Sat 02:00–05:00 UTC. We'll patch edge routers and run a controlled BGP flap + canary failover. Primary goals: verify rollback, exercise regional routing, and validate KV cache warmup. Minimal customer impact expected but treat as a loud window.

linus: Thanks Maya. Can we confirm what the SLO relaxation will be and which routes are eligible for fallback?

maya.sre: Good q. For the window we'll apply a temporary SLO band: p99 request latency SLO relaxed to 150% for affected routes (internal metric: inference.p99_ms). Routing fallback policy: region -> adjacent-region -> hosted-fallback. Only routes tagged "tier:best-effort" will be eligible for fallback to avoid hitting committed capacity.

oliver: Adding runbook link: https://go/redwood/runbooks/us-east-maint — check the preflight checklist in the top section. Also, fill the preflight form so we have a dry-run score.

maya.sre: Preflight checklist highlights: 1) confirm KV prefix warmup scripts queued 90m before window, 2) ensure canary pool (gpucanary-1) healthy, 3) verify rollback playbooks in the discord/ops channel.

linus: KV warmup snippet (use this in CI):
```bash
# populate cache with representative prefixes
python tools/cache_warm.py --region=us-east --prefixes-file=./prefix_sample.txt --parallel=8 --qps=200
```

tamara: On‑call note: I'll be primary for the window, Dave is secondary. If latencies spike beyond 2x baseline for >10m, escalate to SRE Pager and start the fallback policy.

oncall-bot: Reminder: scheduled maintenance created — Pager override set for 2026-03-28T02:00:00Z to 2026-03-28T05:00:00Z. /incident create if you hit p99 > 2x for 10m.

dave: Quick question — will this maintenance affect Dedicated customer capacity or only Hosted?

maya.sre: Dedicated pools will be excluded from automatic routing fallback. We will route only Hosted traffic and best-effort Dedicated if explicitly opted-in by the account. Communicated to account mgmt earlier today.

linus: Any loadtest we should run during the window? I can kick off a short burst to validate autoscaler behavior after patch.

maya.sre: Yes — plan: 5 x 2m bursts at T+30m, T+90m, T+150m, T+210m, T+270m. Target 70% of normal peak QPS. Documented in runbook. Keep bursts short to limit SLO noise.

oliver: Ops checklist item: make sure deploy-bot is muted for the window to avoid noisy deploys.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot muted for maintenance window (1732109876 → 1732115400).

tamara: I'll post a status update every 30m in #incidents and #eng-sre during the window. If anything surprising happens, ping oncall and start the rollback. :thumbsup:

maya.sre: Thanks — final reminder: if you need to test KV warmup locally, use the staging prefix set (staging-prefix-ops). Notify me once your warmup run completes.

oliver: Noted. I'll run a warmup at T-90m and post the results.

maya.sre: Closing thread — point people at the runbook and the preflight form. Appreciate the help, team. :rocket:
